title: On Entries config page, focus search field by default
line: The search field in System Tray settings is focused when the window opens, so you can type right away to find an entry.
explanation: The Entries list on the System Tray settings page has a search field in its header, but nothing gave it focus when the window opened, so typing did nothing until you clicked it. The search field now calls forceActiveFocus() when it is created, so typing filters the entries straight away.

commits.message:
applets/systemtray: focus the Entries search field when settings open

The search field above the list of System Tray entries had no focus when
the settings window opened, so you had to click it before typing to find
an entry. It now takes focus when created, so you can just start typing.

BUG: 467689

                             // the model updates
